note: Frozen drafts from Phase 2A.7 provisional assessments plus positive-control Critical cases. Used for local persist-time before/after comparison only. Not professionally verified truth. Simulated validator outcomes are not actual GPT-4o reanalysis. v3: cross-sheet uncertainty records a limitation without severity downgrade. v4: false date chronology claims are hard-withheld; door hardware/fire-rating absence contradiction when evidence quotes those specs.

softFailContract.description: Severity may be adjusted only for demonstrable on-sheet technical errors (hydraulics, keynote mismatch, clear evidence contradiction). Cross-sheet unread references tag a verification limitation without changing severity or client-facing text. Soft-fail is not withhold/delete. originalSeverity/title/observation remain in raw_metadata.validation. Demonstrably false future-date chronology claims are hard-withheld.
